cands.name: Wellie Jackson
cands.bio: Republican farmer and contract turkey grower for Butterball, and a volunteer firefighter in Keener for more than 20 years. Won the North Carolina House District 22 seat in 2026 after defeating Jerol Kivett in the March Republican primary. He has not held public office before.
cands.gaps: We could not find where Wellie Jackson was born or raised, or when he came to North Carolina. We found no stated positions or past actions on data centers, property taxes, land ownership, growth, immigration and guest workers, policing, guns, abortion, or schools and teacher pay. He did not complete Ballotpedia's 2026 candidate survey, and no campaign platform page was available. No endorsements were listed for him. We found no news coverage of controversies or foreign ties. Nothing was available on his education or on any work beyond farming and volunteer firefighting.

score.why: Raised $0, under $5,000 for this office: too little money to score fairly.

qual.background: Runs a farm as a contract turkey grower for Butterball, and has served more than 20 years as a volunteer firefighter. He has held no prior elected or legislative office.
qual.why: Running a farm business fits the middle band for business owners and managers. There is no record of legislative, policy or budget work, so he scores below the high band.
